label: ext.blocktype ext.migration
createStatement: CREATE (b:ext.blocktype {id: $id, name: $name, properties: $properties, requiredProperties: $requiredProperties, semantics: $semantics, status: $status})

createParameters.name: ext.migration

properties.migrates: the type names whose breaking definition changes this Block covers
properties.rationale: why the breaking definition change is safe or worth its cost

createParameters.semantics: The migration Block a breaking type-definition change must travel with: a reviewed manual artifact whose authority is the ordinary human review of its proposal group. The operations that transform existing content are staged as ordinary operations in the same group; nothing executes the Block. Validation refuses a breaking ext.blocktype or ext.relationtype change whose group carries no ext.migration covering the type. Never materializes to the working tree. BO_0109_007
